specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Ice Spawns and Quasits by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every level (rounded up).
Increases Speed of any Gelugons and Supreme Gelugons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Speed of allied Ice Golems or Frost Golems by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Ballista's Attack and Defense skills by 30% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
Casts Ice Bolt with Damage increased by 10% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
Increases the Speed of allied Frost Creepers or Frost Horrors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Speed of allied Furies or Stygain Furies by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Speed of allied Arachnes or Crystal Arachnes by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
Casts Ice Meteor with Damage increased by 10% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
